item.title: Artificial Intelligence in Commercial Real Estate: The 2025 Breakthrough
item.dc:creator: Sarah J.
item.description: The commercial real estate (CRE) industry in the U.S. is experiencing one of the most transformative periods in its history, driven by the explosive rise of Artificial Intelligence (AI).

item.title: Why Investors Are More Interested in Multifamily Assets
item.dc:creator: Mike R.
item.description: Multifamily real estate remains a top investor choice thanks to steady demand, resilient cash flow, and rising rents, even during downturns. Unlike office properties, it benefits from housing shortages and demographic tailwinds.

item.title: Cap Rate Trends in U.S. Hospitality: What Investors Are Paying
item.dc:creator: Jessica T.
item.description: The U.S. hospitality sector in 2025 shows a complex investment landscape with stabilized cap rates and normalized debt costs around 6.0%–6.5%. Investor confidence is strong, but the market remains bifurcated.

item.title: Understanding GAAP Compliance in Real Estate Accounting
item.dc:creator: David L.
item.description: Navigating the complexities of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) is crucial for real estate firms. This comprehensive guide covers revenue recognition, lease accounting standards, and best practices.
